_doc: Hand-edited per release. Tap the version chip on Home to open. Newest first; trim to ~10 entries.

entries.title: Mastery readout + Home consolidation
notes: New Mastery page with four views: core (JLPT-banded glyph wall), constellation (SVG scatter by maturity), instrument (HUD with XP velocity + maturation calendar), dossier (per-kanji codex cards)
Home gains a 4-cell mastery summary strip (cleared / mature / stable / longest) above the leech panel — tap to open the Mastery page
Home: Countdown + DuePanel + Forecast + RunPrimary collapsed into a single DailyStrip pane
SRS schedule now stamps mastery breadcrumbs onto card states (first_correct_at, first_mature_at, days_overdue_at_lapse) for downstream views
Every mode now writes cross-mode evidence to a new card_events store (Run/TA/Survival/Match/StreakGuard/LeechHunt/Decipher), and each App mount writes a mode_starts row for funnel analysis

Home ambient animations (streak breathe/flicker/shimmer, daily-strip fade, hot-tile glimmer, xp-slide, ladder pulse, void-jitter) share one --kb-beat (1.8s) so they realign on a common downbeat instead of drifting chaotically
iOS PWA fixes: Mastery topbar padded by env(safe-area-inset-top) so Dynamic Island doesn't eat it; visible error fallback + Diagnostics MASTERY + CAPTURE LAYER sections

entries.title: Decipher mode + Dictionary page
notes: New Decipher minigame: key a hidden word kanji-by-kanji with Wordle-style commit feedback (per-position correct / present / absent)
Decipher writes per-kanji card_events on every commit (correct AND wrong) so word-level wins still produce symmetric per-kanji evidence
Word-pick window widened so back-to-back runs vary instead of repeating the same target
Dictionary page: JMdict-derived top-25 example words per kanji, browseable from any kanji surface

entries.title: Streak Inject hardening + SRS leech recovery
notes: Streak Inject: snapshot now self-invalidates when stale + CLEAR SNAPSHOT button in Diagnostics; patched gaps no longer retrigger the inject tile or get confused with real sessions
Streak Inject: calendar key mismatch fixed (was double-counting some days as both patched and real), production odds restored after troubleshooting bypass, unicode checkmark on patched calendar days
Full-gap recovery — INJECT can now patch a multi-day hole, not just yesterday
SRS: weighted leech recovery + centralized leech threshold (lapses ≥ 3)
Settings: deck size selection now reflects saved value on load (was always rendering default)
Diagnostics: gap analysis section, raw detection probe, attempt history; fixed crash from stale Rank.fromXp reference

entries.title: Streak Inject — recover a lost chain
notes: When a streak of ≥2 days lapses 1–7 days ago, Home's OVERCLOCK slot is replaced by a corrupt red INJECT tile (jittering, glitch text, skull motif)
15-card review (no SRS writes); needs ≥12/15 accuracy to roll, then 20% RNG to actually patch the chain
+5% recovery odds per failed attempt (cap 50%), 3 attempts/day, snapshot persists 7 days
+60 XP consolation when accuracy is met but the roll rejects
Daily run always wins the slot first — INJECT only surfaces post-clear so it can't be traded for required practice
Patched gap days render a pixel smiley on the streak calendar instead of empty cells
New-operator safeguards: account age ≥7d AND best_streak ≥3 must hold before the tile can ever appear

entries.title: XP economy — 30-rank ladder + void tier
notes: Rank ladder rewritten end-to-end: 30 ranks across cyan/magenta/amber/transcend/void tiers (Ⅰ NOVICE → ⅩⅩⅩ K̷ANJI.exe)
Void tier (ranks 26–30) carries combining-mark distortion + chromatic-aberration text-shadow + jitter so it reads as unstable
Daily HOT challenge now has a two-tier bonus: GOLD (3×) on the first run of the day, SILVER (1.5×) on subsequent runs
Per-mode XP balances retuned to land N5/N4/N3 finishers at meaningful rank checkpoints

entries.title: Streak celebrations + tap-for-detail panes
notes: Streak ember puff on continue, dust shake on break, magenta twinkle on personal best
Tap any home pane for detail popover (forecast 30-day, deck breakdown, rank ladder, streak history, full leech list, kanji stroke order, ladder tier breakdown)
XP bar fills in on mount, panes stagger-cascade in
Greeting pool expanded; tap version chip for changelog

entries.title: Run polish
notes: Run cards with many readings/examples shrink the kanji instead of scrolling
